review: REVIEWED ORIGINAL SOURCE RECIPE, NOT FIXTURE ACCEPTANCE. Independently reviewed original DOAToVRF.idf SHA256 0b533d3ec7abc449bc592f2853af6fcd994afe8d407075c16b5ec7d0f3eded4c and preserved real-vrf-25-1-20260908T130012.807798800/eplusout.sql SHA256 2e5d6f46d1d0fcf89cd433352faf51fb17a24f47ba0ebe4f0a35679c4408cc0e; executed input SHA256 43d89b5f4dc4e8c3edcd1701cb1180112f6cd2c7079c4845574b32da3217e7dd. This declaration contains original source identities, physical ownership and arithmetic policies, never candidate values or approved expected results. The original native AirConditioner:VariableRefrigerantFlow named VRF Heat Pump references ZoneTerminalUnitList VRF Heat Pump TU List, whose original order is TU3, TU4, TU1, TU2, TU5. Exact typed EquipmentConnections, EquipmentList and terminal/coil references bind TU1 through TU5 to SPACE1-1 through SPACE5-1. SPACE1-1 through SPACE3-1 use InletSide DOAS mixers; SPACE4-1 and SPACE5-1 use SupplySide mixers. PLENUM-1 is not a served HVAC owner. The bounded original outdoor contract is Electricity, AirCooled, no heat recovery, Resistive defrost; each original terminal has its own native VRF cooling/heating coils, draw-through constant-volume fan and no supplemental heater. The separate DOAS has heat recovery and a variable-volume fan but no active cooling/heating coils. There are no PlantLoop or pump inputs. All six original Zone multipliers and SQL Zone/List multipliers are one, with no ZoneGroup. Original MTD membership assigns outdoor cooling plus crankcase electricity to Cooling:Electricity and outdoor heating plus defrost electricity to Heating:Electricity. Each of the five local terminal cooling and heating electricity observations is separately additive to the matching outdoor constituents, not a complete zone-direct system and not an alias of the broad meter. All fourteen exact-key Monthly/J non-meter consumption identities have twelve unique finite nonnegative Weather observations, including ten actual zero rows. Site consumption is already model-total and receives no Zone multiplier. Allocation uses unrounded original selected Monthly load J/3.6e6 times the resolved Zone multiplier once, over every original owner. For each source and month independently, Q=round(source kWh*1000), integer shares use floor(Q*ownerLoad/sum(all owner loads)), with remaining millikWh assigned by largest fractional remainder and canonical original Zone name lexical tie. Main and auxiliary budgets are not rounded as a pooled value. Raw continuous source/share quantities remain separate from displayed integer budgets; Annual is the sum of completed Monthly results, not annual reweighting. Local terminal consumption is added to each Zone's assigned outdoor shares. Missing source or owner load does not become zero or permit a smaller denominator. July heating has positive observed delivered loads but actual zero local, outdoor and defrost consumption. Those thermal loads remain; there is no positive consumption or load-to-end-use conversion for that month. Annual conversion uses only paired positive-load/positive-consumption months. Cooling is reported as coefficient_of_performance; Heating conservatively retains load_to_site_energy, consistent with the current contract for complete electrically supplied delivered-load/site measurements, without claiming equipment-rated COP. The original short RunPeriods are not used as annual evidence: only the runtime annual copy uses recorded January 1 through December 31 2017 controls. Original equipment, geometry, schedules and timestep are unchanged. Compared with the preserved 20260907T163246.984246400 capture, the new executed input adds only fourteen Monthly Output:Variable objects. All 3,984 previous Monthly values and all 455,520 previous Timestep values remain exactly unchanged. Previous TU1 and outdoor Timestep observations are retained as context, never a second additive input. Original TU1 Fan Electricity Rate remains observed, but no complete measured roster or supply-flow allocation proof establishes separate local and DOAS fan pools. The complete broad Fans:Electricity therefore remains explicitly unassigned; the observed TU1 fan is not added again. The six-Zone delivered-load authority is Zone Air System Sensible Cooling/Heating Energy Monthly/J; Rate/W alternatives are fallback preference, not additive. Twelve real zero plenum load observations per service (24 total) remain known. No Zone latent-load observations are invented from coil or heat-exchanger outputs. The independently audited pressure declaration uses the same sixteen physical source families as the common original DOAS geometry: five SPACE People, Lights, ElectricEquipment and infiltration owners, six Zone air/surface/internal balance observations, and PLENUM-1 outdoor unsplit context rather than fabricated infiltration. Forty original BuildingSurface:Detailed plus six FenestrationSurface:Detailed identities resolve all forty-six Monthly surface convection sources: eight outside walls, one roof, five ground floors, six windows and twenty-six interzone surfaces. No InternalMass or adiabatic/self surface is introduced. No positive-load/exact-zero-pressure fallback or alternate Hourly trace declaration is required by this original capture. Seven Monthly/J site declarations cover electricity cooling, heating, fans, lighting, equipment, heat recovery and facility. HeatRecovery:Electricity reports twelve actual zeros. Natural gas, district energy, pumps and water-system sources are absent and are not copied as zeros from another model. Five Zone lighting and equipment inputs are separately observed and sum to their broad meters. All forty declared availability groups were requested; their original observation roster independently yields Drivers 13/19, Loads 6/14, End uses 6/6 and Carriers 1/1. The fourteen native VRF constituents are additional source/allocation checks, not additional end-use coverage categories. The native run completed in 17.62 seconds with 11,724 warnings and zero Severe errors; original warning evidence is preserved. The model describes Miami while this catalog retains Chicago weather SHA256 c7d4efcf93ba316a1d874352e743df5cf137ba5c0e3459eb2dc4b5442d5b7f5c. Numerical conversion checks do not certify climate suitability or physical design adequacy. Fixture approval still requires complete eight-group numerical and field coverage, explicit independent pending review, expected packaging, prior-fixture replay and saved acceptance; this source declaration does not approve a candidate.
